boosters_i18n.zh-TW: 費爾班克斯西北約 45 公里的穹丘頂是高地極光點：360 度無遮擋地平線、極光帶正頭頂；條件由夜窗＋雲況決定，極光本體的可見性由即時 aurora_state（NOAA OVATION）判定，未連線前誠實 fail-closed。
boosters_i18n.en: A hilltop aurora lookout about 45 km northwest of Fairbanks with a 360-degree unobstructed horizon under the auroral oval; the contract decides the night window and cloud state, while actual aurora visibility is judged by the live aurora_state (NOAA OVATION) provider and stays fail-closed until that link is connected.
boosters_i18n.ja: フェアバンクス北西約45kmの丘上オーロラ展望地。360度の開けた水平線。契約は夜間窓と雲状態を判定し、オーロラ自体の可視性はNOAA OVATIONのaurora_stateにより判定（未接続時はfail-closed）。
